workingTreeCandidate.scope: Domestic media compatibility restoration: new images use the established standard gateway endpoint; account video models retain their established group-session gateway route without new capability metadata prerequisites; queue, request identity and existing billing rules remain unchanged.

knownLimitations: 3.0.38 was built from clean source commit 4d2e27a680b79de92bbef3d379cc59cfdb89ae3e. The domestic Direct APK is a test candidate, not a production release.

Toolchain doctor, TypeScript, documentation checks, 149 focused Jest tests, Direct Firebase validation, offline Gradle signing, artifact packaging, independent signature verification and overlay-upgrade eligibility verification passed. No deployment, Play artifact or production publication occurred.

New image requests now directly use POST /v1/images/generations or POST /v1/images/edits with the selected image-group session. The optional async image task helper remains only for historical persisted task reconciliation and is not a new-request prerequisite.

Non-grok_video models again submit through their selected purpose=video group session to POST /v1/videos and query /v1/agnesapi. grok_video remains on its existing mobile task API. Optional adapter, capability_version, availability and price fields no longer disable account-returned video rows; no backend group, model, price, account, billing or database setting was changed.
Real-device acceptance remains required for image generation and queue continuation, video group/model submission and result polling, local-material recovery, and four-language UI flows.
